workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the time slots where both of them are free next week (Monday Nov 16 - Friday Nov 20, 9:00-17:00):

- Monday: 09:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Could you check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars to see which of these slots work for both of them? Please let me know the overlapping times and we can book the meeting.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against the slots you provided. Unfortunately, none of the slots where Priya and Marcus are both free work for Elena and David:

- Monday 09:00-10:00: Elena is busy 09:00-10:00 (Contract review + Recruiting call)
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Elena is busy 13:00-14:00 (Quarterly planning + Contract review)
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Elena is busy 16:30-17:00 (Hiring panel)
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: David is busy 15:00-15:30 (Partner lunch) and 15:30-16:00
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena is busy 10:00-10:30 (Hiring panel)
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Elena is busy 11:00-12:00 (Client dinner prep + 1:1 with associate)

Could you double-check Priya and Marcus's calendars to see if there might be other overlapping free times? Or are you seeing the same issue? I want to make sure we haven't missed anything before considering this infeasible.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've double-checked Priya and Marcus's calendars very carefully, and my original list of overlapping free times is correct:

- Monday: 09:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

I went through each 30-minute slot day by day and these are the only times both Priya and Marcus are free. If Elena and David are all blocked during these slots as you indicated, then there genuinely is no time when all four partners can meet.

Could you confirm your analysis is correct? If so, we'll need to report this as infeasible since there's no overlapping availability for all four partners next week.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
